family_reports.body: Caused detrimental emotional and financial hardship, stolen years of our lives and forcing us to Fight for our constitutional rights and Justice.
Autauga County family court has failed my children and me over and over again. More than 30 years of mental and physchological abuse has been legally perpetuated at the hands of the court system.

This court has aided in the psychological abuse and alienation of two children from their life long family support network of grandparents, cousins, and aunts and uncles that they have had no contact with, with no reason stated by parents and absolutely no evidence of harm in any fashion.

public_comments.comment_text: Proceeds where jurisdiction does not allow. Failure to follow rules of court, ignores state statues, failure to acknowledge jurisdiction. Motion filed, Judge Calhoun allowed Father 7 days to respond, his response did not acknowledge statue or jurisdiction limits, Judge Calhoun then ignored all and left motions hanging. Subjected children to re visit trauma in therapy in spite of previously completing therapy, therapist recommended no contact, GAL recommended no contact. Father has been convicted of sex crimes with children the named victims and contact supervised or not would violate state statue. Judge does not Have jurisdiction to rule or consider ruling in violation of state law, doing so would be a violation of due process and equal protection under the law .
